readerCopy.body: An institution creates a durable response to a need it once handled through temporary goodwill. Saturn trine Neptune can turn volunteers and emergency exceptions into long-term funding, trained staff, private space, and clear access without losing sight of the human reason the program exists. Care becomes dependable because someone accepted that compassion needs a budget after the emotional moment passes. Protect that continuity. Build the plan so the service still works on an ordinary Tuesday when nobody is watching.
